The '''angroosh''' was a creature invoked in the saying "no better than a [[throg (creature)|throg]]-bellied, soft-spined, blue-haired angroosh" meaning someone who doesn't stand a chance in a particular situation.<ref name="Cracken">''[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|Cracken's Rebel Field Guide]]''</ref>
